compiled_state.title: Capture Anthropic response.usage to review-cycle-usage.json with fcntl lock in dispatch.py
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-1: After /dso:review run, ${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/review-cycle-usage.json contains Anthropic API usage.input_tokens and usage.output_tokens for each reviewer dispatch.

## Implementation Notes
Edit `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/dispatch.py`: after each successful litellm.completion() call (in dispatch_review, dispatch_two_call_review, and augmentation-loop re-completions), extract `response.usage.input_tokens` and `response.usage.output_tokens` and append/upsert entry to `${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/review-cycle-usage.json` (path via existing `_resolve_artifacts_dir()` helper).

Format: JSON object keyed by `{cycle_number}.{agent_id}.{dispatch_index}`. Each value: `input_tokens`, `output_tokens`, `model`, ISO-8601 timestamp.

Use `fcntl.flock(LOCK_EX)` for concurrent-write serialization — async_dispatch_specialists runs 3 reviewers in parallel via asyncio.gather. Lock is load-bearing.

Stdlib only — fcntl + json. Use `getattr(response, 'usage', None)` defensively.

Add new file: `tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_usage_capture.py` with 3+ tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file exists with ≥3 test functions
  Verify: test -f tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_usage_capture.py && [ "$(grep -c '^def test_' tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_usage_capture.py)" -ge 3 ]
- [ ] Happy-path usage capture works
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_usage_capture.py::test_dispatch_review_writes_usage_json -x
- [ ] Concurrency: parallel writes preserved by fcntl lock
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_usage_capture.py::test_concurrent_writes_preserved -x
- [ ] Missing-usage tolerance: response without .usage does not raise
  Verify: python -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_usage_capture.py::test_missing_usage_silent -x
- [ ] No new runtime dependency
  Verify: ! git diff HEAD -- pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^\+' | grep -qvE '^\+\+\+'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 1/6): Specify usage.json write semantics. dispatch.py calls litellm.completion at 6+ sites + dispatch_two_call_review runs reviewers in parallel. AC must specify: (a) append-per-reviewer-dispatch (NOT overwrite), each entry tagged by agent_id + cycle + call_index; (b) under fcntl.LOCK_EX, read-modify-write atomic; (c) lock-file path = ${ARTIFACTS_DIR}/.review-cycle-usage.lock co-located with usage.json. Add RED test: 4 concurrent dispatch_review calls → 4 entries in usage.json (not 1).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 2/6): Define ARTIFACTS_DIR resolution + JSON schema. Use cycle_ledger._resolve_artifacts_dir() (honors WORKFLOW_PLUGIN_ARTIFACTS_DIR env, falls back to /tmp/workflow-plugin-<sha256(REPO_ROOT)[:16]>/). Pin schema: {schema_version: '1.0.0', cycles: [{agent_id, cycle, call_index, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, timestamp_iso}]}. Capture cache fields already extracted by _check_cache_usage at dispatch.py:241-245.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 3/6): Handle litellm response.usage shape (NOT Anthropic-native). dispatch.py uses litellm.completion — usage is OpenAI-shape (response.usage.prompt_tokens, response.usage.completion_tokens). Story description says 'Anthropic API usage.input_tokens' which is wrong. AC must specify: read .prompt_tokens as input_tokens, .completion_tokens as output_tokens, guard cache fields with getattr(usage, 'cache_read_input_tokens', None). RED test must use litellm-shaped mock, not Anthropic-native.
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 4/6, ex-finding 7): Add rollback/idempotency for usage.json on dispatcher exception. If litellm.completion succeeds + usage written but _parse_response raises, usage entry remains while review record is absent — cost-attribution leak. Add try/except around dispatch_review main path: on uncaught exception, write usage entry with additional 'review_outcome': 'failed' + exception class/message. RED test: monkeypatch _parse_response to raise; assert usage.json entry exists with review_outcome=failed.
comments.author: Test
